productType: SaaS Desktop Workspace — macOS-style study workspace with an embedded AI Agent (Electron + Next.js)
visualTone: Frosted floating-glass surfaces over a soft ambient wallpaper. Dark default is a warm-neutral charcoal glass (reference: Glass Music Player 5) — heavy backdrop blur, high saturation boost, 1px top inner highlight, hairline dividers, large continuous corner radius, white primary action. Two light tints: misty aqua-blue glass and warm cream/butter glass. Everything reads as layered translucent panes, never flat opaque cards.

themes.defaultDark: Warm-neutral charcoal deep glass, like Glass Music Player 5 over a dim warm-gray wallpaper
themes.lightAqua: Misty pale-blue frosted glass (light mode option A)
themes.lightCream: Warm pale-butter/cream frosted glass (light mode option B)

glassSignatures.primaryAction: Pure white circular/elevated control in dark; ink control in light
glassSignatures.ambient: Soft blurred color blobs behind glass (aqua/violet/amber), wallpaper-driven

brandHeritage.existingMark: Notebook glyph, cream #f4efe6 ground with burnt-orange #d9542c stroke
brandHeritage.existingM3Primary: #a8c7fa blue (legacy Material 3, being superseded by glass language)
